overall_goal: Clean equipment, measure ingredients, and prepare the workspace for cooking

goals.description: Disassemble the food processor and clear out stuck biscuits
goals.rationale: The person takes apart the food processor lid and blade, shaking and hitting the components to ensure all crushed biscuits fall into the bowl.

goals.description: Measure additional crushed biscuits and consolidate them
goals.rationale: The person uses a glass to measure more crushed biscuits from the food processor bowl, pours them into the main bowl, and secures the equipment.

goals.description: Stir the carrot soup on the stove
goals.rationale: The person briefly attends to a pot of carrot soup on the hob, stirring it with a spatula before covering and moving it.

goals.description: Retrieve and prepare a Tupperware container for weighing
goals.rationale: The person searches the cupboards to find a Tupperware container, removes its lid, and places it on the scale.

goals.description: Set up the scale and notepad for recording weights
goals.rationale: The person turns on the scale, prepares a fresh sheet of paper on the notepad, and writes down the first ingredient to be weighed.

goals.description: Weigh the crushed biscuits and record the measurement
goals.rationale: The person carefully pours the crushed biscuits into the Tupperware on the scale, notes the weight on the notepad, and then empties the biscuits into a large bowl.
The person writes butter on the notepad, places a pot on the scale, and resets it to zero.

goals.description: Store the remaining butter in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person wraps the leftover butter in its packaging and places it in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Close the cocoa container and record its measurement
goals.rationale: The person seals the can of cocoa powder, moves it aside, and writes its weight on the notepad.

goals.description: Check the melting butter and update the notepad
goals.rationale: The person checks the butter melting in the pot and marks a question mark on the notepad for a forgotten measurement.

goals.description: Search drawers to find the can opener and retrieve foil
goals.rationale: The person looks through multiple drawers, moving items around to locate a can opener, and also takes out a box of foil for later use.
